LanguageData.AG_TimeBubbleFormed: {0} collapsed a stasis field. Everything inside is out of the fight until it lifts.
LanguageData.AG_TimeBubbleTooltip: Freezes everything within {0} cells for {1} seconds, including your own pawns and the caster. Nothing inside can be harmed.
LanguageData.AG_DisarmNeedsPawn: Must target a person or mech.
LanguageData.AG_OverdriveOutOfFood: {0}'s metabolic overdrive ran out of food reserves and shut down.
LanguageData.AG_OverdriveNothingToHeal: {0}'s metabolic overdrive shut down with nothing left to heal.
LanguageData.AG_StrainInjury: {0}'s temporal strain tore something in their {1}. The damage is permanent.
LanguageData.AG_RecursionUp: {0} opened the halving membrane. Nothing will reach them - and they have stopped breathing.
LanguageData.AG_RecursionCollapsed: {0}'s halving membrane closed. Everything that was on its way arrived at once.
LanguageData.AG_RecursionCloseDesc: Let the membrane collapse and start breathing again. Everything currently held short - every round drifting in, every blow still arriving - lands in the same instant.
LanguageData.AG_ReflectionUp: {0} reversed their vectors. Nothing aimed at them will land - and nothing can reach them, including help.
LanguageData.AG_ShoveNeedsPawn: Must target a person, animal or mech.
LanguageData.AG_ResonanceUp: {0}'s strikes are ringing. Anything struck twice in the same place comes apart - including them.
LanguageData.AG_ResonanceBroke: {0}'s {1} was struck in phase and came apart.
LanguageData.AG_ArrearsUp: {0} stopped reporting. Nothing that happens to them will land until the plexus tells them.
LanguageData.AG_ArrearsDue: {0}'s plexus reported. {1} damage arrived at once.
LanguageData.AG_ArrearsSettledEarly: {0} took the news early. {1} damage arrived at once.
LanguageData.AG_ArrearsSettleDesc: Tell the body now. Every wound on the books lands in this instant, wherever the carrier is standing - which is the point of doing it early, while that is somewhere with cover and a doctor in it.
LanguageData.AG_AnchorFull: {0} is already holding {1} marks. Take one back first.
LanguageData.AG_AnchorNeedTwo: {0} needs two marks to clap them together.
LanguageData.AG_AnchorTwoTiles: Two marked patches of ground have nothing to exchange.
LanguageData.AG_AnchorNoWeapon: The clap needs both hands. {0} is holding {1}.
LanguageData.AG_AnchorCannotEquip: Needs both hands free to clap.
LanguageData.AG_LanceCharging: {0}'s lance is lit. Anything still on the line in a second and a half will be on it when it fires.
LanguageData.AG_LanceNeedsDirection: The lance needs a direction. Aim away from the carrier.
LanguageData.AG_LanceTooltip: Charges for {0} seconds in full view, then deals {1} damage to everything left on the line. Reaches {2} cells, or the first wall.
LanguageData.AG_LarynxNoVoice: {0} has no voice left to spend.
LanguageData.AG_LarynxTooltip: Costs at least {0} larynx strain, multiplied by how hard the target was going to be to talk to. Deaf targets do not hear it at all.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteVented: {0} connected the hole in their {1}. Anything that finds it now goes through.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteClosed: {0}'s hole is not connected to anything.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteFoldedIn: {0} folded out of the world. The hole is off them and standing where they were - anything fired into it arrives beside them.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteFoldedOut: {0} came back through. The aperture is still standing - anything fired into it lands among their stores.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteNoWayBack: There is no aperture left. {0} has no way back.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteTooBig: {0} does not fit through the hole.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteNeedsPawn: Must target a person, animal or mech.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteNotSelf: The hole does not lead to itself. Fold instead.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteNeedsItem: Must target an item. People go through with swallow.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteCollapsed: {0}'s volume collapsed. Everything that was in it is gone.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteCantCollapseInside: {0} cannot collapse the volume while standing in it.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteNoVolume: There is no volume to collapse.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteApertureOccupied: The carrier is on the other side.
LanguageData.AG_InvoluteApertureIdle: Open. Nothing on the other side but what was put there.
